name: Nagypall (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over yellow, charged in the upper hoist with a white disc bearing the municipal arms of Nagypall with a helm and blue and yellow mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Nagypall arms with helm and mantling
